findings.claim: Local user UUID is not connected to JWT subject in inspected auth path
findings.trigger: First Google sign-in followed by an API request requiring local current_org_id
findings.effect: If framework token.sub differs from the generated database UUID, workspace lookup returns no workspace or a database error; launch-critical AI and billing flows fail.
counterevidence: Authentication library implementation is not present; token.sub behavior has not been executed. No assertion of actual production failure.
upsertUser creates and links a local workspace; failure is identity propagation rather than absence of provisioning.
findings.remedy: Map returned local user id into signed token/session and verify an isolated sign-in-to-query integration test.

findings.trigger: Two requests read the same remaining allowance before either update
findings.effect: Both can invoke paid AI and persist the same increment; runtime exploitation not executed.
counterevidence: Prompt length is bounded at route lines 50-59.
Identity issue FG-01 may prevent this path until fixed; logged-in reachability is conditional on valid local user identity.
findings.remedy: Atomic bounded reservation before paid work, idempotency and failure reconciliation.

findings.claim: Payment event retries can reset consumed allowance
findings.trigger: Repeat invoice.payment_succeeded after allowance was consumed
findings.effect: Usage is reset to zero again; signature checks do not deduplicate event delivery.
counterevidence: No endpoint invoked or provider delivery replay executed.
findings.remedy: Persist unique invoice/event application and reset atomically; test replay and ordering in isolation.

findings.claim: Webhook update results are not checked before acknowledgement
findings.trigger: Database update returns error field without throwing
findings.effect: Handler returns received=true although entitlement write failed, preventing ordinary webhook retries.
counterevidence: Exact installed Supabase failure behavior not exercised; error-checking pattern elsewhere supports the hypothesis.
findings.remedy: Check mutation error results and make retries safe.

decision.rationale: Source-level accounting/retry mechanisms and unresolved launch-critical identity mapping prevent recommending scoped public paid launch; operational evidence gaps remain.
